note: Removes the component's date-sync effect and URL precedence helper; shared Kea logic gains a dashboardExternalDateFilters selector and dashboard-date reducers/actionToUrl, with logic tests.
Moves CSV export into a new membersExportLogic and replaces the inline regex slug with the existing slugify helper from lib/utils.
Adds a cast-free evaluationsApi facade (evaluationFromApi narrowing, listAllEvaluations, patchEvaluation) and removes the as-unknown-as casts and create/update actions from the logic.
Drops the local ingestionLimits helper and uses billingLogic.isProductOverUsageLimit for product analytics and session replay, mounting visionQuotaLogic to load billing.
Removes the inline hmac/sha256 computation and imports compute_signature from ee.api.agentic_provisioning.signature.
Replaces the icontains run search with the shared apply_trigram_search helper over branch and run_type, keeping exact SHA-prefix and PR-number matches; adds a trigram migration.
Moves the bot-PRs flag check to feature_flags.py with flag key slack-app-bot-prs and renames continue-as-bot log events from posthog_code_ to slack_app_.
Adds an origin-uuid marker dedup in apply_handler and a new raced-chain test in merge_protocol.rs; no fixtures are lifted into a shared tests/common module.
Moves batchId out of EventFiltersBatchContext into a new IngestionBatchContext that extends it and spreads the incoming batch context; the step is still typed to the concrete context, not generic.
Adds a static _assert_web_experiment_has_control helper and calls it from create, launch validation, and update (keeping the update_variants guard).
